verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents recovery when a pipeline breaks. A dead-letter queue with a reprocessing worker lets failed events be replayed, and Kafka buffers data while a warehouse is offline and delivers it once the warehouse is back. Deduplication makes resending the same data safe. Nothing in the evidence shows replaying archived history into a newly added destination. Missing for 10: replay of archived events into a new destination, backfill of historical data when a tool is added, documented replay controls such as time ranges, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can replay archived events into a new destination or backfill history when a tool is added or a pipeline breaks

citations.quote: Dead-letter queue with a reprocessing worker: failed events can be replayed instead of lost.
Jitsu will keep your data in a Kafka and deliver it once the warehouse is back online
Send same data as many times as you want. Jitsu will deduplicate it for you
